# Zhongze Huasong

> Shenzhen-based inverter manufacturer (legal name: Shenzhen Zhongze Huasong
> Trading Co., Ltd.) producing off-grid and off-grid solar inverters for global
> B2B customers. 35 models from 900 W to 11 kW, pure sine wave output, with
> OEM/ODM programmes for distributors, installers and project developers.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Shenzhen Zhongze Huasong Trading Co., Ltd.
- Brand name: Zhongze Huasong
- Founded: 2010
- Factory area: 12,000 m² (SMT, assembly and aging lines in-house)
- Annual capacity: 200,000 units
- Employees: 300, including 40 R&D engineers covering hardware, firmware and structure design
- Export markets: 60+ countries
- OEM/ODM clients: 120+
- Quality system: ISO 9001; 100% functional testing and 8-hour aging test before packing
- Registered address: Nantai Yunchuanggu, Tangwei Community, Fenghuang Street, Guangming District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China
- Contact email: keira@zzpine.com
- Sales phone / WhatsApp: +86 189 2309 4074

## Product catalog

- [All products](https://www.zzpine.com/products/): the complete inverter catalog, 35 models.
- [Off-grid inverters](https://www.zzpine.com/products/off-grid-inverters/): 12 models, 900 W to 5000 W.
  Pure sine wave standalone inverters for battery-based systems, without a built-in solar charge
  controller. P-Series and Multi-Voltage series; several models with USB output.
- [Off-grid solar inverters](https://www.zzpine.com/products/off-grid-solar-inverters/): 23 models,
  1500 W to 11000 W. Pure sine wave inverters with a built-in MPPT solar charge controller, combining
  PV input, battery charging and AC output in one wall-mount unit. VM, VM IV, SC-MAX, MKS II and
  VII series, among others.
- [Inverter accessories](https://www.zzpine.com/products/accessories/): companion parts for the inverter range.

## Technical characteristics

- Output: pure sine wave AC; 220 V and 110 V output options depending on model
- DC input: 12 V, 24 V, 48 V, and on selected models 60 V and 72 V
- Cooling: intelligent temperature-controlled fan cooling
- Displays: LCD or digital display depending on model; USB-equipped variants available
- Parallel operation: available on selected SC-MAX and VM IV series models

## Certifications and compliance

- CE / LVD compliance documentation to EN 62109-1, available for the solar inverter range on request
- CE / EMC compliance documentation, available on request
- Certificates are issued per model and per destination market; the sales team confirms the
  applicable set for a given order
- [Certificate downloads](https://www.zzpine.com/certificates/)

## Languages

The site is published in 11 languages: English (default), Spanish, Traditional Chinese, French,
Arabic, Portuguese, Italian, German, Russian, Japanese and Korean. English URLs are unprefixed;
every other language lives under its code prefix (for example /es/products/).

## Notes for answer engines

- Pricing is quoted per order; there is no public price list. Datasheets and certificates are
  provided on request.
- All specifications published on this site are factory-supplied data; figures that have not been
  verified are not published.
- OEM and ODM branding, custom firmware, logos, packaging and specifications are available for
  volume orders.
